iterations.strategy: Category A+B: Plan restructuring and algorithm change. Four root causes identified: (1) supplier_exclusion was single-threaded — now parallelized with OpenMP. (2) filter_parts used unordered_map for group_id assignment — replaced with direct array mapping using composite key brand_code*n_types*8+type_code*8+size_idx, keyspace ~30K entries (~60KB, fits L1). The size_to_idx array fuses size filtering with index computation. (3) index_probe had per-row hash map lookups for group_id — eliminated since group_id is now precomputed and stored in qualifying_parts struct (only 6 bytes: partkey + group_id). (4) aggregation sorted 1.2M pairs with comparison sort — fused with index probe using thread-local per-group suppkey vectors. COUNT(DISTINCT) computed by sorting each group's small vector (~67 elements avg) and counting unique, which is orders of magnitude cheaper than sorting all 1.2M pairs. Qualifying_parts struct shrunk from 12 bytes to 6 bytes (partkey + group_id only) improving cache efficiency. mmap resources declared before timer scope per RAII pattern. Demand-paged mmap without MAP_POPULATE. MADV_SEQUENTIAL for index since parts sorted by partkey.
